description: This file contains libc hook implementations and system call integrations for Zephyr RTOS, including stdio stream setup, hooks installation, locking mechanisms, assertions, and error handling.

methods.name: z_impl_zephyr_fputc
methods.description: Implementation of fputc that calls the stdout hook.

methods.name: __stdout_hook_install
methods.description: Installs a hook function for stdout.

methods.name: __stdin_hook_install
methods.description: Installs a hook function for stdin.

methods.name: __retarget_lock_close_recursive
methods.description: Releases resources for a recursive lock.

methods.name: __retarget_lock_close
methods.description: Releases resources for a non-recursive lock.

methods.name: __retarget_lock_try_acquire_recursive
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a recursive lock without blocking.

methods.name: __retarget_lock_try_acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a non-recursive lock without blocking.

methods.name: __assert_func
methods.description: Handles assertion failures with detailed info.

methods.name: z_errno_wrap
methods.description: Wrapper for z_errno to avoid including Zephyr headers in libc.
